title: Soft delete an item
gherkin:
Feature: Soft deletion of items
  Scenario: Mark an item as deleted
    Given an item exists in the system
    When the user marks the item as deleted
    Then the item should be marked as deleted but still exist in the system
rationale: To verify that an item can be soft deleted and remains retrievable in the system.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the soft deletion rule requirement, ensuring that items can be marked as deleted without being permanently removed from the system.
